title: One Stretch Before Bed
cut_style: Memphis design cutouts, bold geometric shapes, squiggles and dots in bright colors
voice: Friendly, clear, brisk narrator at about 170 WPM, warm and encouraging.

cuts.doorway_chest_stretch: Simple flat paper illustration of a person standing in a doorway with forearms on the frame, gently leaning forward, no text, bright Memphis geometric accents.
cuts.slumped_shoulders: Side-view flat paper illustration of a seated person with rounded shoulders looking at a phone, no text, playful squiggles and dots around them.
cuts.soft_open_arrow: Curved paper arrow with small sparkle shapes suggesting gentle opening and release, no text, bold bright Memphis colors.
cuts.relaxed_posture: Flat paper illustration of a person standing tall with relaxed shoulders and an easy neutral spine, no text, colorful geometric accents.
cuts.sleep_bed: Simple paper bed with pillow and a crescent moon above it, no text, bright Memphis shapes and dots.
cuts.round_timer: Cute round kitchen timer paper cutout with a simple dial and no numbers or text, bold colorful Memphis style.

scenes.vo: One stretch before bed. That's it.
Tight chest pulls shoulders forward all day.
Doorway stretch opens your chest gently.
Easier shoulders can let posture relax.
Hold thirty slow seconds before sleep tonight.
Get your personal routine in TallPlan.
